name: rgs-batch-console
description: rgs-batch-console Node 22 + 原生 http + 0 依赖, per BATCH-PLAN v0.2 §3.1 W1 BA-W1-1~4, AGENTS.md v0.4 §7 batch 域母规范, E3 派工 13 endpoint (9/8 20:30 JST E3 派工)

scripts.test:health: node -e "const http = require('node:http'); const endpoints = ['/api/v1/health', '/api/v1/version', '/api/v1/token-estimate?text=hello', '/api/v1/grpc-status']; let pending = endpoints.length; for (const ep of endpoints) { http.get('http://127.0.0.1:8789' + ep, r => { console.log(ep, r.statusCode); pending--; if (pending === 0) process.exit(0); }).on('error', e => { console.error(ep, e.message); pending--; if (pending === 0) process.exit(1); }); }"
